maddeler.e:
نحتقن (form VIII)
# نَحْتَقِنُ (naḥtaqinu) /naħ.ta.qi.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَقَنَ (iḥtaqana)
# نَحْتَقِنَ (naḥtaqina) /naħ.ta.qi.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَقَنَ (iḥtaqana)
# نَحْتَقِنْ (naḥtaqin) /naħ.ta.qin/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْتَقَنَ (iḥtaqana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
